evidence.quote: VICTOZA is indicated: - as an adjunct to diet and exercise to improve glycemic control in adults and pediatric patients aged 10 years and older with type 2 diabetes mellitus,
The mean age of participants was 57 years, and the mean duration of diabetes was 7 years. Participants were 58.2% male, 87.1% White and 2.4% Black or African American. The mean BMI was 31.0 kg/m^2.

response.reasoning: The claim states that VICTOZA improves blood sugar control in people with type 1 diabetes, but the label excerpts only mention type 2 diabetes mellitus. There is no mention of type 1 diabetes in the indications or clinical studies sections.
